title: 和直属上司的一对一会议应该谈什么
topic: 和直属上司的一对一会议应该谈什么

source.title: 1-1 | The GitLab Handbook
source.section: 1-1 agenda format and cadence (5 paragraphs selected for this lesson)
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: GitLab Handbook 的 1-1 页面内容较长；学习页聚焦一致的一对一议程、双方共同添加主题（多数由 team member 提出）及会议频率/同步偏好，展示相关完整 5 段。
paragraphs: Maintaining an effective and efficient agenda is important to get the best out of the 1-1 (read as: one to one) meetings you have with your team members. Furthermore this page will take you through other tips and tricks to conduct an effective 1-1 meeting.
Make sure you use a consistent agenda format for each 1-1.
Both parties add items to the agenda. Preferably, the majority added by the team member. If the manager puts more than half of the items on the agenda this is an indication that something is wrong.
Reference the suggested format for leadership as necessary.

It’s advisable to schedule 1-1’s at least once a week. The choice of synchronous or asynchronous meetings can be made by the manager and their direct report, depending on their preferences and needs. To avoid prolonged periods without face-to-face communication, it is preferable for the manager and their direct report to have a minimum of two regularly scheduled synchronous 1-1s every month, barring any PTO or leave from work. For example, some managers schedule 1-1s on alternating weeks, with one week for synchronous meetings and the next week for asynchronous meetings. This approach allows for more dedicated focus time and aligns with our priority of emphasizing asynchronous communication.
translations: 保持一个有效且高效的议程对于充分利用您与团队成员进行的 1-1（读作：one to one，即一对一）会议至关重要。此外，本页面将引导您了解其他技巧和方法，以有效地进行 1-1 会议。
确保您为每次 1-1 会议使用一致的议程格式。
双方都可以向议程添加项目。最好，大部分由团队成员添加。如果经理在议程上添加的项目超过一半，这表明出了问题。
必要时，请参考领导层建议的格式。
建议每周至少安排一次一对一。经理和直属下属可以根据各自的偏好与需要，决定采用同步会议还是异步沟通。为避免长时间没有面对面交流，除休假等情况外，双方最好每月至少安排两次定期同步的一对一。有些经理会隔周安排：一周同步开会，下一周异步沟通。这样既能留出专注工作的时间，也符合团队优先采用异步沟通的做法。
fullTextParagraphs: Maintaining an effective and efficient agenda is important to get the best out of the 1-1 (read as: one to one) meetings you have with your team members. Furthermore this page will take you through other tips and tricks to conduct an effective 1-1 meeting.
Make sure you use a consistent agenda format for each 1-1.
Both parties add items to the agenda. Preferably, the majority added by the team member. If the manager puts more than half of the items on the agenda this is an indication that something is wrong.
Reference the suggested format for leadership as necessary.

It’s advisable to schedule 1-1’s at least once a week. The choice of synchronous or asynchronous meetings can be made by the manager and their direct report, depending on their preferences and needs. To avoid prolonged periods without face-to-face communication, it is preferable for the manager and their direct report to have a minimum of two regularly scheduled synchronous 1-1s every month, barring any PTO or leave from work. For example, some managers schedule 1-1s on alternating weeks, with one week for synchronous meetings and the next week for asynchronous meetings. This approach allows for more dedicated focus time and aligns with our priority of emphasizing asynchronous communication.

notes.explain: 这是职场中管理者与下属定期进行的单独交流会议，用于讨论工作进展、解决问题和提供反馈。
notes.example: Maintaining an effective agenda helps us get the best out of our weekly 1-1.

notes.explain: 指每次一对一会议都使用相同的议程结构，这样可以提高会议效率并确保讨论重点一致。
notes.example: Both the manager and team member add agenda items before the 1-1.

notes.phrase: Both parties add items to the agenda
notes.explain: GitLab 建议议题多数由 team member 添加；如果经理添加了超过一半的议题，可能表示一对一的运作出现问题。
notes.example: I added two topics to our shared agenda before the 1-1.

notes.explain: 同步会议指实时进行的面对面或视频会议，异步会议则指通过邮件、文档等方式进行的非实时交流。
notes.example: Our remote work policy allows teams to choose between synchronous or asynchronous meetings based on project needs.

scenario.title: Bring your own priorities to a one-to-one
english: Your weekly 1-1 with your manager is twenty minutes long. The shared agenda currently has two status items from your manager.
You want to add the customer migration as your top priority and leave time to discuss your development goals. You would also like specific feedback on how you handled the launch review.
Ask which topic to start with, request that feedback, and agree on one follow-up action before the meeting ends.
chinese: 你和经理每周进行一次 1-1，时间为二十分钟。当前共享议程上有经理添加的两项状态内容。
你想把客户迁移列为首要议题，也想留时间谈发展目标；你还希望获得关于自己如何处理上线评审的具体反馈。
询问先谈哪一项，请求反馈，并在会议结束前约定一项后续行动。

firstAttempt.prompt: 你和经理的一对一只有二十分钟，共享议程上已有经理提出的状态更新。请用英文把客户迁移添加为你的优先事项，针对主持上线评审的能力请求具体反馈，并在结束前约定一项下一步。
firstAttempt.sample: I’d like to add the customer migration as my top priority on our shared agenda. Could we discuss that first, then could you give me feedback on how I handled the launch review? Before we finish, let’s agree on one action I can take before our next check-in.
firstAttempt.rationale: 一对一议程由双方添加内容；明确自己最想讨论的主题，再请具体反馈并约定行动。

words.example: I added the project blocker and development goals to our one-to-one agenda.
words.translation: 我把项目阻碍和发展目标加进了一对一议程。
words.note: 在职场中，提前分享议程可以让与会者做好准备，提高会议效率。

words.example: A consistent one-to-one agenda helps us revisit open topics.
words.translation: 固定的一对一议程有助于我们继续跟进未完成的话题。
words.note: 在管理中，保持一致性可以建立清晰的期望和标准。

words.example: The majority of employees prefer flexible working hours to a fixed 9-to-5 schedule.
words.translation: 大多数员工更喜欢灵活的工作时间，而不是固定的9点到5点的工作时间。
words.note: 指超过半数的多数；the majority of 后接群体或数量。

words.example: I’ll bring the project notes for reference during our one-to-one.
words.translation: 一对一时我会带上项目记录作参考。
words.note: 在工作中引用相关资料可以增强论点的可信度。

words.example: Could we schedule a follow-up to discuss my development goals?
words.translation: 我们能否再约时间讨论我的发展目标？
words.note: 良好的时间安排是高效工作的关键，特别是在管理多个项目时。

words.example: If we run out of time, I can send the other topic asynchronously.
words.translation: 如果时间不够，我可以异步发出另一个话题。
words.note: 在远程工作中，异步沟通可以提高效率，减少会议时间。

structure.original: Maintaining an effective and efficient agenda is important to get the best out of the 1-1 (read as: one to one) meetings you have with your team members.
analysis: 主语是'Maintaining an effective and efficient agenda'，其中动名词短语'Maintaining...'作为整个句子的主语，'effective and efficient'是并列形容词修饰'agenda'
谓语部分是'is important'，系动词'is'和表语'important'构成系表结构
不定式短语'to get the best out of the 1-1 meetings you have with your team members'作为目的状语，修饰'is important'，其中'you have with your team members'是定语从句修饰'meetings'
structure.transfer: I have twenty minutes and want to discuss both the project blocker and my development goals. Which should we start with?

rewrite.bad: Let’s talk about the budget first, even though I also have a project blocker and a development topic.
rewrite.good: I’d like to add the customer migration as my top priority on our shared agenda. Could we discuss that first, then could you give me feedback on how I handled the launch review? Before we finish, let’s agree on one action I can take before our next check-in.
rewrite.translation: 我想把客户迁移作为首要事项添加到我们的共享议程上。我们能先谈这个吗？之后请你反馈一下我主持上线评审的表现。结束前，我们约定一项我在下次沟通前可以完成的行动。
rewrite.pattern: I’d like to add [priority] to our shared agenda. Could we discuss it first, then could you give me feedback on [specific skill]? Let’s agree on [one next action].

cloze.prompt: I’d like to add the customer migration as my top priority on our shared ___.
cloze.why: shared agenda 是一对一双方共同添加议题的位置。

cloze.prompt: Could you give me ___ on how I handled the launch review?
cloze.why: 具体地请求 feedback，便于聚焦能力表现。

cloze.prompt: Before we finish, let’s agree on one ___.
cloze.why: 以行动项收束谈话，方便下次跟进。

dictation.text: Make sure you use a consistent agenda format for each 1-1.
Both parties add items to the agenda. Preferably, the majority added by the team member.

translationPractice.prompt: 我想把客户迁移作为首要事项添加到我们的共享议程上。
translationPractice.answer: I’d like to add the customer migration as my top priority on our shared agenda.
translationPractice.why: add ... to our shared agenda 说明把议题放进双方可见的一对一议程。

translationPractice.prompt: 你能反馈一下我主持上线评审的表现吗？
translationPractice.answer: Could you give me feedback on how I handled the launch review?
translationPractice.why: ask for feedback on + 具体表现，比泛泛问“做得好吗”更容易得到可用反馈。

translationPractice.prompt: 结束前，我们约定一项我在下次沟通前可以完成的行动。
translationPractice.answer: Before we finish, let’s agree on one action I can take before our next check-in.
translationPractice.why: agree on one action 让谈话留下可跟进的下一步。

choice.prompt: 一对一只有二十分钟。经理已在共享议程放入状态事项；你想优先谈客户迁移、请对方反馈发布评审表现，并商定下一步。哪种开场最清楚？
options: Can we talk about whatever comes up? We do not need an agenda or action.

I’d like to add the customer migration as my top priority on our shared agenda. Could we discuss that first, then could you give me feedback on how I handled the launch review? Before we finish, let’s agree on one action I can take before our next check-in.
Could you tell me whether I am doing well in general?
choice.why: 明确自己提出的议题，提出具体反馈请求，并约定下一步。

output.prompt: 你的下次 1-1 只有十五分钟。请把 API 交接添加为首要议题，围绕主持跨团队评审请求具体反馈，并约定你在下次 1-1 前完成的一项行动。
output.sample: I’d like to add the API handoff as my top priority to our shared agenda. Could you give me feedback on how I handled the cross-team review? Before we finish, let’s agree on one action I can take before our next 1-1.
check: 是否把自己的优先议题加到共享议程？
是否针对具体工作表现请求反馈？
是否约定一项下次沟通前能完成的行动？
